ads.headline: Rohtak mein industrial plot
ads.text: Factory ke liye land? Forteasia Industrial Township, Kalanaur, Rohtak. 500 se 4,000 sq yd ke plots, 18 m aur 24 m wide roads, NH-152D se 10 min. HRERA-PKL-ROH-653-2025, www.haryanarera.gov.in. Neeche button par click karke aur jaaniye.
ads.prefill: Hi, FIT industrial plot ki details bhejiye.

ads.name: P11 reel 3 things HQ
ads.headline: Industrial plots, Rohtak
ads.text: For factory owners: 3 things a planned industrial plot gives you. Roads 18 m and 24 m wide, built for trucks. 10 min to NH-152D, 25 min to IMT Rohtak. HRERA registered with DTCP licences. Forteasia Industrial Township, Kalanaur, Rohtak: plots 500 to 4,000 sq yd. HRERA-PKL-ROH-653-2025, www.haryanarera.gov.in. Click the button below to know more.
ads.prefill: Hi, I saw the FIT ad. Please share the industrial plot details.
